title: Serene Loft Downtown Nashville
description:
Keep it simple at this cozy, peaceful, central location. Located Downtown Nashville, Tennessee. Walking distance to bars, restaurants, and other landmarks within minutes. Walking distance to the limelights of Nashville. The Gulch, and Broadway. Resort style pool area, full gym, lounge and grill area. 

Permit number T2022050484

The space
Cozy 1 bedroom apartment includes a queen size bed with storage drawers for extra blankets, or clothes. Comfortable, cool bed with changeable led lights that Bluetooth to the beat of music. Charger ports on headboard. A queen size air mattress available for extra guest. Living room area has a couch, flat screen tv, Wi-Fi accessible. Open concept, full kitchen with pots, pans, coffee maker and snacks, full bathroom, laundry room, patio to lounge and enjoy a partial skyline view of the city.

Guest access
Entire apartment except storage closet
